title: Ask your data.
takeaway: Ask a question scoped to selected scientific records.
proof: The same 12 geographic observations become highlighted rows and a composer reference. A genuine PTC program reads those records and computes the peak before the answer appears.
limits: Authored reference gesture using actual NOAA rows and Natural Earth geometry. The read/maximum calculation is retained native execution; public activity labels condense it and do not invent model reasoning.
hardest: Keep map labels as stable DOM text and preserve the selection through the reference handoff, record read, computation and answer.
